if miku_love >= 50 and christmastwo20 == True and mikudorm45p2 == True and mikuspecial50 == False:

else:
I tap on Miku's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Miku 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Heya!
lines.zh: : 嗨呀！

lines.en: : Need something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 有事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I was just about to head over to the park to do some laps. Wanna join me?
lines.zh: : 我正要去公园跑几圈。要不要一起来？

lines.en: : Didn't you literally just finish soccer practice?
lines.zh: : 你不是刚踢完足球训练吗？

lines.en: : Yup! Which means it's time for practice round two! You comin' or not?
lines.zh: : 对啊！也就是说第二轮训练开始了！你来不来？

lines.en: : I'll come, but there is no way I am going to do any actual running.
lines.zh: : 我来，但我绝对不会真的跑。

lines.en: : That's fine! Just be a creeper and sit on the bench while ya watch my bag or somethin'!
lines.zh: : 没事！你就当个变态，坐长椅上帮我看包什么的就行！

lines.en: : I'm going to the one near the[school], so just come there whenever ya can! Bye bye!
lines.zh: : 我要去[学校]旁边那个，你能来就来吧！拜拜！

lines.en: scene black
scene mikugennoon
I show up at the park to find Miku waiting for me on the ledge of a fountain.
lines.zh: 我到公园的时候，Miku 正坐在喷泉边上等我。

lines.en: She must have come directly from practice since she still has her bag with all of her stuff in it.
lines.zh: 她大概是从训练场直接过来的，包还背着，东西全在里面。

lines.en: I have absolutely no idea how she's filled with so much energy that she needs to wash down practice with {i}more{/i} practice-
lines.zh: 我完全搞不懂她哪来那么多精力，练完一轮还要用{i}更多{/i}的训练把上一轮冲下去——

lines.en: But I guess there's still a lot I don't really understand about Miku in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，关于 Miku，我搞不懂的事本来就不少。

lines.en: After spending a few minutes talking to me, it becomes clear that she's getting anxious and needs to get the rest of her energy out.
lines.zh: 跟我聊了几分钟之后，很明显她开始坐不住了，得把剩下的精力发泄出去。

lines.en: I agree to watching her things and then subsequently watch {i}her{/i} as she takes off down the walking trail, carefully avoiding several women out walking their dogs or their children.
lines.zh: 我答应帮她看东西，然后就看着她顺着步道跑出去，小心翼翼地绕开几个遛狗或者遛孩子的女人。

lines.en: Well, I guess you don't technically {i}walk{/i} children. But you might as well considering they're essentially useless.
lines.zh: 严格来说，孩子不是用来「遛」的。不过考虑到他们基本上没什么用，也差不多。

lines.en: More people should just get dogs.
lines.zh: 大家都该养条狗。

lines.en: scene black with dissolve
Miku only winds up running for ten minutes or so before deciding to call it for the day and spend more time with me.
lines.zh: Miku 最后只跑了十来分钟就决定收工，把时间留给我。

lines.en: But, with the sun already starting to set and daylight beginning to die out, I decide it's best to just walk her back to the dorm and get on with the rest of my night...
lines.zh: 但太阳已经开始落了，天色慢慢暗下来，我决定还是把她送回宿舍，然后继续过我剩下的夜晚……

lines.en: $ miku_love += 1
lines.zh: $ miku_love += 1

lines.en: {i}Miku's affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}
